science.title_part2: Works Differently at the Best Age.
science.description_1: Scientifically proven: Your brain learns lifelong. Contrary to outdated myths, the mature brain is by no means less capable – it is more specialized. While conventional methods often rely on the fast processing of young brains, I use your greatest strength: your crystalline intelligence and your lifelong accumulated knowledge.
science.description_2: Successful learning in old age requires methods that use the natural adaptability (neuroplasticity) of your brain. I create new neural connections by linking new words directly with your valuable life experiences. This way, what is learned stays not only in your head but becomes part of your everyday life.

card1.title: Learning Without Pressure: Why Our Specialization Makes the Difference.
card1.text: State standard courses are often designed for a broad spectrum of learners but rarely take into account the changed perception channels and the individual learning pace of the mature learners. I know that diminishing hearing in loud classrooms or too fast speaking tempo of teachers can trigger stress. My method starts where others stop: I create a quiet, barrier-free learning environment with clear structures and plenty of room for repetition. I use modern geragogy (age didactics) to ensure that you not only learn German but also find joy in progress – completely without performance pressure.

card3.title: Proven in practice.
card3.text: For 2 years, I led German courses for the Ukrainian Association in Lower Saxony e.V. Through my work in welcome classes and as a student assistant in the field of German as a Second Language at the University of Hannover, I know the real hurdles you face.

card4.title: Two mother tongues: German & Russian.
card4.text: I grew up completely bilingual. This allows me to explain complex rules directly in your native language. To understand your perspective as a learner even better, I am currently learning Turkish myself – so I know exactly how it feels to start all over again.

about_v2.headline: Anastasia Sitov - Founder & Teacher
about_v2.subline: As an expert in language acquisition in old age and M.Ed. Teaching Biology & German, I know: Every person learns as individually as their own fingerprint. Since I grew up fully bilingual (German & Russian), I know the hurdles of switching between two worlds first-hand. My approach combines current research on neuroplasticity with empathic learning support at eye level.
about_v2.body: I explain complex rules directly in your native language so that you feel secure from the beginning. Currently, I am learning Turkish myself – so I remain with you on the journey of discovery and know exactly how it feels to start anew.

sections.title: § 1 Scope of Application, Provider
content: (1) These General Terms and Conditions (GTC) apply to all contracts for participation in language courses, language training, private lessons, online courses, and other services of the Sitov Language Academy (hereinafter "Language School").
Provider:
Sitov Language Academy
Hüttenstraße 24a, 30165 Hannover, Germany
E-Mail: info@sitov-academy.com
Authorized Representative: Anastasia Sitov
(2) Deviating or supplementary conditions of the participant are only binding if the Language School confirms this in writing.

sections.title: § 2 Subject of Contract
content: (1) The subject of the contract is the services specified in the respective course description (scope of services, course duration, dates, teaching materials). The course description is an integral part of the contract.
(2) Minor changes in the course schedule, teaching staff, or class times are permissible, provided that the overall character of the course is not significantly impaired.
(3) Online instruction is conducted via common video conferencing software (e.g., Microsoft Teams). The participant is responsible for a suitable internet connection and technical equipment.
(4) For quality assurance and review purposes for participants, online sessions are recorded. The details regarding the use of these recordings are set out in § 9 of these GTC.

sections.title: § 3 Registration and Conclusion of Contract
content: (1) Registration can be made online via the website, by e-mail, by written registration form, or personally on site and constitutes a binding offer by the participant.

(2) In the case of written registration using a paper form, the contract is concluded with your signature on the registration form. You will receive a written or e-mailed confirmation of registration.

(3) In the case of online registration, the contract is concluded as soon as the Language School confirms the registration in writing (e.g., by e-mail). The registration confirmation can be combined with the invoice for the course fee.
(4) The Language School reserves the right to reject registrations for good cause (e.g., overcrowding, inappropriate language level).

sections.title: § 4 Prices, Payment Conditions, Subscription Model
content: (1) The currently valid prices are those listed in the price overview published on the website. All prices are final prices. According to § 19 UStG, no sales tax is charged.

(2) The course fee is invoiced monthly in advance. The contract is automatically renewed for one additional month unless the participant actively cancels or fails to pay the invoice for the following month within the specified period.
(3) Payment of the follow-up invoice constitutes active consent to continued course participation for the respective following month.

(4) Non-payment of a follow-up invoice within 14 days of receipt is treated as automatic cancellation effective at the end of the current billing month. In this case, no additional costs are incurred by the participant.
(5) Payment is made by bank transfer after receipt of invoice, unless otherwise agreed.
Bank details:
Account holder: Anastasia Sitov
BIC: NTSBDEB1XXX
Bank: N26 Bank SE
Reason for payment: Invoice number
(6) In case of late payment, statutory default regulations (§ 288 BGB) apply only if the payment was announced but not made within the specified period.

sections.title: § 5 Right of Withdrawal (Consumers / Distance Contracts)
content: (1) If the contract was concluded via distance selling (e.g., by e-mail or online registration), the participant, who is a consumer within the meaning of § 13 BGB, has a statutory right of withdrawal.
(2) The details result from the following cancellation policy.

sections.title: Cancellation Policy
content: (1) If you have a right of withdrawal, you can exercise it by making a declaration to the Language School. You may use the attached model withdrawal form for this purpose, but it is not mandatory.
(2) To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient for you to send your communication concerning your exercise of the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period has expired.
Consequences of withdrawal:

If you withdraw from this contract, we will reimburse to you all payments received from you, promptly and at the latest within 14 days from the day on which we received your notification of withdrawal.
For this repayment, we use the same means of payment that you used for the original transaction, unless expressly agreed otherwise with you.

Compensation for value: If you requested that the service (e.g., the course) begin during the withdrawal period, you must pay us a reasonable amount corresponding to the proportion of the services already provided up to the time you inform us of the exercise of the right of withdrawal compared to the total scope of the services provided for in the contract.
Special note on premature expiration:

The right of withdrawal expires in the case of a contract for the provision of services even if we have completely provided the service and have only begun to perform the service after you have given your express consent to this and at the same time confirmed your knowledge that you lose your right of withdrawal upon complete performance of the contract by us.

sections.title: § 6 Non-participation / Illness
content: (1) The course fee covers access to the courses in the respective month. In case of non-participation in individual teaching units (e.g., due to illness or vacation), there is no claim for reimbursement or replacement hours.
(2) On a goodwill basis, the Language School may offer make-up opportunities or replacement dates, provided this is organizationally possible.

sections.title: § 7 Cancellation by the Language School / Replacement Services
content: (1) If classes are cancelled for reasons for which the Language School is responsible (e.g., illness of the teacher) and no replacement date can be offered, the pro rata course fee will be refunded.
(2) Further claims, in particular damages, are excluded, unless there is intent or gross negligence.

sections.title: § 8 Liability
content: (1) The Language School is liable only for intent and gross negligence. In cases of simple negligence, it is liable only for the breach of essential contractual obligations (cardinal obligations) and limited to the typical, foreseeable damage.
(2) For damages resulting from injury to life, body, or health, statutory liability applies without limitation.
(3) The Language School assumes no guarantee for a specific learning success.
(4) Liability for loss or damage to personal belongings is assumed only in cases of intent or gross negligence.

sections.title: § 9 Copyright and Video Recordings
content: (1) Course materials are protected by copyright and may be used exclusively for personal use. Passing on, duplication, or publication is prohibited without the express written consent of the Language School.

(2) Video and audio recordings created as part of online courses are also protected by copyright. The copyrights belong exclusively to the Language School. The recordings are made available to participants of the respective course for a limited time for learning purposes.

(3) Sharing of the recordings, access credentials, or public display (e.g., on social media) by the participant is strictly prohibited and may result in exclusion from the course. The participant has no claim to an error-free recording or permanent availability.

sections.title: § 10 Contract Duration and Cancellation
content: (1) With the initial payment of the course fee, an ongoing contract for participation in the course programme is concluded.

(2) The contract is automatically renewed for one additional month at a time, unless the participant actively cancels or the invoice for the following month is not paid within the specified period. Non-payment of the follow-up invoice constitutes automatic cancellation (cf. § 4 para. 4).

(3) Cancellation may be declared at any time without any particular form (e.g. by e-mail, via the cancellation form on the website, or by message via a messenger service) and takes effect at the end of the current billing month.
(4) After cancellation — whether active or by non-payment — course participation can only be resumed through a new registration.
(5) This subscription model is designed to minimise unnecessary administrative effort for both parties and to make course participation as straightforward as possible.

sections.title: § 11 Data Protection
content: The collection and processing of personal data takes place in accordance with the GDPR and the BDSG. Further information can be found in the privacy policy on the website of the Language School.

sections.title: § 12 Final Provisions
content: (1) German law applies.
(2) The contract language is German.
(3) If the participant is a consumer, the statutory place of jurisdiction of their residence applies.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights as a Data Subject
content: As a data subject, you have the following rights at any time:
- Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR): You have the right to request information about your personal data processed by us.
- Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR): You have the right to demand the immediate correction of incorrect or completion of your personal data stored by us.

- Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR): You have the right to demand the deletion of your personal data stored by us, unless processing is necessary for exercising the right of freedom of expression and information, for compliance with a legal obligation, for reasons of public interest or for the establishment, exercise or defense of legal claims.
- Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR): You have the right to demand the restriction of the processing of your personal data.

- Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR): You have the right to receive your personal data that you have provided to us in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format or to request transmission to another controller.
- Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR): If your personal data are processed on the basis of legitimate interests pursuant to Art. 6 Para. 1 S. 1 lit. f GDPR, you have the right to object to the processing.

- Right to withdraw consent (Art. 7 Para. 3 GDPR): You have the right to withdraw your consent to us at any time. This has the consequence that we may no longer continue the data processing based on this consent for the future.
- Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR): You have the right to complain to a data protection supervisory authority about the processing of your personal data by us.

sections.title: 8. Data Collection on our Website
content: 8.1 Hosting and Server Log Files
To ensure the secure and stable operation of our website, we use hosting services from the following provider:
IONOS SE, Elgendorfer Str. 57, 56410 Montabaur, Germany

We have concluded a data processing agreement (DPA) with this provider in accordance with Art. 28 GDPR. This contract ensures that the provider processes the data of our website visitors only in accordance with our instructions and in compliance with the GDPR.
When you visit our website, our host automatically collects information that your browser transmits (so-called server log files). These are:
- IP address (is usually stored anonymously)
- Date and time of the request
- Content of the request (concrete page)
- Access status/HTTP status code
- Website from which the request comes (Referrer URL)
- Browser and operating system

Legal basis: The processing is carried out on the basis of our legitimate interest (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. f GDPR) in a technically error-free presentation and the guarantee of the stability and security of our website.

Storage period: The IP addresses of visitors are anonymized in the server log files after 7 days. The anonymized log files are then stored for 8 weeks and then deleted. After anonymization, it is no longer possible to trace back to your person.
8.2 Cookies

Our website uses cookies. Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device. We use exclusively technically necessary cookies that are required for the basic operation of the website (e.g. to save the language you have selected).
We do not use cookies for analysis, tracking or marketing purposes.

Legal basis: The use of these technically necessary cookies takes place on the basis of our legitimate interest in a user-friendly and functional provision of our services (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. f GDPR).

Storage period: Most of the cookies we use are so-called 'session cookies'. They are automatically deleted after your visit. Other cookies (e.g. for language selection) remain stored on your device until you delete them. You can check your browser settings to be informed about the setting of cookies and only allow cookies in individual cases or exclude the acceptance of cookies for certain cases or generally.
8.3 Registration for Courses
If you register for a course via our website, by e-mail or by paper form on site, we collect the data necessary for the execution of the contract:
- Name and First Name
- Contact details (E-Mail, Phone)
- Address details
- Booked course data
- Further voluntary information that you have provided to us

For offline registrations: The data from the signed paper form are manually entered by us into our course management system (Supabase, Frankfurt). The original form is kept by us in accordance with the statutory retention periods. For offline registration, we additionally collect your handwritten signature on the registration form.
Legal basis: The processing of this data takes place for the implementation of pre-contractual measures and for the fulfillment of a contract (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. b GDPR).

Storage period: We store this data until the expiry of the statutory warranty and limitation periods. Data subject to accounting obligations (e.g. invoices) are stored in accordance with statutory periods (usually 10 years according to HGB and AO).
8.4 Course Support and Homework (Telegram)

For communication with the teacher, the exchange of homework and daily course support, we use the messenger service Telegram. Participation in the Telegram channel/group is optional, but recommended for optimal course support.
Provider: Telegram Messenger LLP, Dubai, United Arab Emirates / Telegram FZ-LLC, Dubai
Server locations: Distributed worldwide (exact locations are not public)
Processed data:
- Telegram username and user ID
- Profile picture (if available)
- Phone number (depending on your Telegram settings)
- Messages, homework, shared files and media
- Metadata (timestamp, IP address on connection)
Purpose: Fast communication between teacher and participants, exchange of homework, provision of learning materials, organization of the course flow, answering questions.

Legal basis: The use of Telegram takes place on the basis of your express consent according to Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. a GDPR. By joining the Telegram group, you consent to data processing by Telegram. You can withdraw your consent at any time by leaving the Telegram group or informing us by e-mail.
Notes on data protection risks:
- No standard end-to-end encryption: Normal chats and group chats are not end-to-end encrypted. Only 'Secret Chats' offer this function.
- Server locations: Telegram stores data on servers distributed worldwide. The exact locations are not transparent.
- Third country transfer: Data transfer takes place to countries outside the EU that do not offer an equivalent level of data protection.
- Metadata: Telegram stores metadata (who communicates with whom) for up to 12 months.
- Access by authorities: Depending on the server location, local authorities may demand access to data under certain circumstances.
- Alternative communication: If you have concerns regarding Telegram, you can alternatively communicate with us by e-mail. We strive to ensure good course support even without Telegram.

Storage period: Messages in Telegram groups are stored for the duration of the course and up to 6 months after the end of the course, unless the group is deleted earlier. You can delete your own messages yourself at any time.
Further information on data protection at Telegram: https://telegram.org/privacy
8.5 Contact (E-Mail, Phone)
If you contact us by e-mail or phone, the data you provide (your e-mail address, possibly your name and phone number) will be stored by us to answer your questions.
Legal basis: Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. b GDPR (for contract initiation) or Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in efficient communication).
8.6 Google Maps
On our website we use the offer of Google Maps. This allows us to display interactive maps directly on the website and enables you to use the map function comfortably (e.g. for directions).
Provider: Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland.
Parent company: Google LLC, 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA.

Important: The map is not loaded by default. Only when you actively click on the button 'Show Map' (two-click solution), a connection to the Google servers is established. Your IP address and possibly location data are transmitted to Google.
Legal basis: The use of Google Maps takes place exclusively on the basis of your consent according to Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. a GDPR. You grant this consent by activating the map.

Third country transfer: By using Google Maps, data can be transmitted to the USA. Google relies on the 'EU-US Data Privacy Framework'. Nevertheless, we point out that access rights by US authorities may theoretically exist in the USA.
Further information on data processing by Google can be found in Google's privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.title: 9. Video Conferencing Tools and Lesson Recordings (Microsoft Teams)
content: For the delivery of our online courses, we use Microsoft Teams.
Provider: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited, One Microsoft Place, South County Business Park, Leopardstown, Dublin 18, Ireland (parent company: Microsoft Corporation, USA).
9.1 Type and Purpose of Processing
When using Microsoft Teams, various types of data are processed. The scope of data also depends on the information you provide before or during participation in an online session.
Processed data: Meeting metadata (e.g. date, time, meeting ID), audio and video data (your voice and image), text inputs (chat function) as well as video recordings of the teaching sessions.
Purpose of recording: The recordings serve exclusively the participants of the respective course for review and revision of the learning content.
9.2 Legal Basis
The use of Microsoft Teams for the general delivery of instruction is based on Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. b GDPR (performance of contract).

The video recording of sessions takes place exclusively on the basis of your express consent pursuant to Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. a GDPR, which you grant during course registration via a mandatory checkbox.
9.3 Storage Duration and Access

The video recordings are stored in a protected environment (e.g. password-protected cloud storage from Microsoft). Access is strictly limited to the instructor and the registered participants of the same course. No disclosure to third parties takes place.
The recordings are permanently deleted no later than 30 days after the completion of the respective course.
9.4 Withdrawal of Consent

You may withdraw your consent to recording at any time with effect for the future. Please note that the course concept of our online B1 courses is based on these recordings; a withdrawal may therefore result in further participation in online instruction being technically or organizationally no longer possible.
9.5 Data Transfer to Third Countries (USA)

When using Microsoft Teams, data processing in the USA may occur. The transfer is based on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) as well as supplementary Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs). Microsoft is DPF-certified. Please note the general risks of third-country transfers (theoretical access possibilities by US authorities).
Further information: https://privacy.microsoft.com/de-de/privacystatement

sections.title: 10. Data Security
content: We use the widespread SSL procedure (Secure Socket Layer) in connection with the highest encryption level supported by your browser during the website visit. You can recognize whether a single page of our internet presence is transmitted in encrypted form by the closed representation of the key or lock symbol in the address bar of your browser.

sections.title: 11. Validity and Amendment of this Privacy Policy
content: This Privacy Policy is currently valid and has the status November 2025. Due to the further development of our website or due to changed legal requirements, it may become necessary to change this Privacy Policy.

reviews_subtitle: 5.0 out of 5 based on Google Reviews

reviews_data.author: Vitalii Raevskii
reviews_data.text: I am very glad I found Smart German. After several unsuccessful attempts to learn German, I had almost lost faith in myself and my motivation. But thanks to the teacher's approach, everything changed: learning became understandable, at a comfortable pace, and really very interesting.

reviews_data.author: Viktoriia Viktoriia
reviews_data.text: Anastasia is a very good and attentive German teacher. The lessons are always interesting and never boring, the material is explained calmly and understandably. I recommend the course to everyone who wants to improve their German skills.

reviews_data.author: Valeriia Varych
reviews_data.text: An excellent school opened by an excellent German teacher! Thanks to her and her approach, German opens up from a completely different side. She explains the logic and structure of the language. I am studying at the B2 level, and even during grammar explanations, I was not bored at all.

reviews_data.author: Оксана Абрамович
reviews_data.text: In just 4 months of lessons, I have noticed great progress in the German language. The most amazing thing for me is that the words are memorized naturally, without endless rote learning. Thank you for the patience, support, and the great teaching method!

reviews_data.author: Maksym
reviews_data.text: A huge thank you to Anastasia for this fantastic language training! Nastia does a great job of involving you in the conversation and totally motivates you to speak in German. After every meeting, you just have positive emotions and gain self-confidence.

reviews_data.author: Андрей Иванов
reviews_data.text: I am very satisfied with these courses! The material is explained simply and accessibly, and the lessons help to adapt faster in the country. There is noticeable progress in learning the German language. Highly recommended.
